selected_evidence.source_summary: Adult breeding movements occur on rainy nights, usually November through April, sometimes outside that interval. Seasonal pools and adjacent burrow habitat remain necessary.
selected_evidence.caveat: This restricts the illustrated adult rainy-night arrival vignette only. Aquatic breeding activity and juvenile dispersal, including dry-weather May-July movements, are not claimed absent. CDFW historical account emphasizes Nov-Feb whereas current USFWS gives broader Nov-Apr; use the broader season set.

save_layout_proposal.caution: Root final selection contract uses quest9 bits1..4; preserve bit0, taxonomy bit6 and audio bit7. Legacy lowbits zero decode fair/winter; fresh defaults select spring/fair nibble4 (quest9=72). Existing photo conditions remain unknown until recaptured.

accessibility_contract.camp_choice: Player may choose any of four forecast windows and any season at a reached ranger camp, then keep current phase or rest to the required phase. Menus preview the selection and accept/cancel with no RNG or real-time date.
accessibility_contract.bound: At most three increments per selector from any value; required pairs available in all16 districts. No species gate or ending prerequisite to access weather controls.
accessibility_contract.story: Ordinary focused visible photographs remain2stars; weather controls never raise existing story photo quality thresholds.
accessibility_contract.safe: Forecast represents a calm fictional observation window, not playable hazardous weather or guidance to enter storms. Keep water boundaries/shore-only rules unchanged.
accessibility_contract.no_random_rarity: Once correct habitat, phase and window are selected, existing bounded encounter lookup remains available; no additional arbitrary rain-roll RNG.
